label: RexAB system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a bacteriophage-lambda Rex-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder RexAB__RexA and RexAB__RexB profiles and exemplified by the rexA and rexB two-component system that aborts lytic growth of bacterial viruses.
observations: RexAB branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual rexA or rexB genes, RexA or RexB proteins, bacteriophage lambda prophages, the DefenseFinder RexAB__RexA or RexAB__RexB HMM profiles, source database rows naming one RexAB locus, phage exclusion outcomes, unresolved sensitive-phage triggers, lambda self-exclusion control, and generic abortive infection systems.
